name: Tachibana Kanae
source:
Shizuka's younger sister and a popular TV announcer. She is the same person as Kanae from "Princess Ryouzoku Housou".

In addition to her original lewdness, she has been raped by the producer of the TV program, and her thoughts about sex are no longer those of a normal person.

She is the kind of woman who would even hang herself if her master ordered her to do so. This time, she visited her sister by chance.
